name: KLF transcription factor 4

function.text: KLF4 encodes krueppel-like factor 4. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
